Commands, always in view

Every command with its short keys and plain words. Any of them can be typed in the command field below.
CommandShortPlain wordsWhat it does
helphshow help, what can I doShow every command
aboutaabout this os, what is thisAbout this kernel
cpucshow cpu, cpu infoCPU information
memmshow memory, memory usageMemory usage
selftesttsttest, run tests, check systemRun the built-in tests
lsllflist files, show my filesList RAM files
cat NAMErrfread NAME, open NAMERead a RAM file
new NAME TEXTnCreate a RAM file; never overwrites one
write NAME TEXTwsave TEXT to NAMEWrite or replace a RAM file
rm NAMEddfdelete NAME, remove NAMERemove a RAM file after you confirm
alloc BYTESbAllocate bytes from the kernel arena
echo TEXTePrint text
clearxclear screenClear the guest display
haltqHalt the guest CPU after you confirm
run UTILITYrun tests, run files, run notepadRun a built-in utility; outside programs are not supported yet
file creatorfmfmake file, new fileOpen the form that makes a file with a suggested name

f or “make file” opens the file creator. lf lists files, rf NAME reads one. Press Tab in the command field to complete a suggestion.

First boot milestone

Measured from implementation start to the first working QEMU shell. A small research milestone, not commercial OS parity.

58

QEMU checks passed

Boot, commands, memory bounds, RAM files, PS/2 keyboard and native mouse-driven file creation. This browser uses the same verified disk image.

32 MB

Emulated guest memory

Software-emulated x86 hardware, powered by v86. No guest network relay, shared folders or host device access.

A foundation, with a usable browser workspace.

The kernel has no process isolation, persistent storage, network stack or browser. It cannot run Edge, Claude or Codex yet. Edge hosts this VM; it is not running inside the guest. Android hardware and modern UEFI support remain future work.

Use only test text. This is not a security sandbox or a safe place for secrets. The VM pauses when the tab is hidden to save CPU.
